function.name: LongBoneFractureReduction
function.description: Guided interactive workflow for LongBoneFractureReduction. Execute steps in order. Interactive steps require user 3D interaction. Steps: 'cb_step_1': In the "Input volume" section, select the CT volume for processing.; 'cb_step_2': If ROI crop of the volume is required, check the "Crop the input volume to an ROI" box. If not, jump to step 7.; 'cb_step_3': In the "Markups" module, click "ROI" to create an empty MarkupsROI node named "Longbone_Region".; 'cb_step_4': Manually click and adjust on the Slice views to create the ROI for the "Longbone_Region". (interactive: roi); 'cb_step_5': In the "ROI (Drawn in Markups)" section, select the MarkupsROI node.; 'cb_step_6': Click the "Cofrim crop" button.; 'cb_step_7': In the "Segment Editor" module, create a new segmentation named "Reference_Segmentation".; 'cb_step_8': In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Add" button and rename the segment to "Reference_Segment" under "Reference_Segmentation", and set its color to Sage Green.; 'cb_step_9': In the "Segment Editor" module, click the "Threshold" button.; 'cb_step_10': In the "Segment Editor" module, adjust the threshold slider to set the segmentation range.

user_action.description: Action: 'start' to begin a step, 'proceed' after user completes interaction, 'skip' for optional steps, 'cancel' to abort workflow, 'choice_made' for user_choice steps

choice_value.description: Value selected by the user for user_choice steps. Required when user_action is 'choice_made'. A multi-selection step takes a JSON object mapping each parameter_name to its value.
